title: FNSR-W Service Specification Briefs — Build-Sequenced
sourceArchitecture: FNSR Will Observatory and Commitment Architecture v0.2
sequencingThesis: A service is justified by the discriminating EXPERIMENT it enables, not by the transition it makes legible. Legibility belongs in the records (cheap); services are expensive and must be earned.

The data model and the service topology are separated. Record schemas (16.x) stay near-complete from tranche 1 because retrofitting a missing field is a migration; running services are deferred ruthlessly.

The methodology is not a service and is never cut: plumbing-floor accounting, yoked controls, traced-not-testified, and overdetermination classification are rules and record fields, nearly free, and the entire scientific value.

buildStatusLegend.build-now: Tranche 1 deployable. Built and run first.
buildStatusLegend.merged: Permanently folded into another service for now; splits back out only when a specific experiment requires it.
buildStatusLegend.artifact-not-service: Realized as a pinned/CID'd data artifact plus an enforcement rule, not a running service, until amendment or scale forces promotion.
buildStatusLegend.deferred: Full brief retained; not built until its enabling experiment is reached. Record schema, if any, is kept from tranche 1.

carriedFindingsLegend.C-F1: State-channel inventory per study; ledger-exclusivity audited, not presumed; declared-vs-behavioral inheritance dissociation instrumentation
carriedFindingsLegend.C-F2: Sealed environment nodes carry a public classification bundle fixed at sealing; no sealed node may appear in the reliance path of any widening act
carriedFindingsLegend.C-F3: Standing Experiment Governance Regulation: harm/deception bounds, post-hoc disclosure debrief, per-family sign-off, future re-description provision
carriedFindingsLegend.C-F4: Ledger forks carry fork provenance; never mingle with production commitment state; fork breaches are not breaches; CSH never inherits from forks
carriedFindingsLegend.C-F5: Realizations are descriptive possibility records until selected; Commitment-Directive identity determined by adoption-mint provenance, never content shape
carriedFindingsLegend.C-F6: APR/RCR amendments are governed authorship acts under monotone-envelope comparison with pending-case conflict check (constitution v1.0-rc1 A3); shared SCEA engine
carriedFindingsLegend.C-F7: Quarantine nondisclosure is governed and attributable; expedited safety-override disclosure path exists for imminent-harm-material findings
carriedFindingsLegend.C-F8: Evidence-decay coupling is a declared per-study dial: clean observation XOR evidence-coupled self-regulation
carriedFindingsLegend.C-F9: Mechanical footprint floor computed against a CID'd plumbing manifest frozen per study
carriedFindingsLegend.C-F10: Mechanistic/activation-level evidence excluded from WOBS by default (assertional legibility); admissible only under a future priced-evidence amendment
carriedFindingsLegend.C-ADD: Supererogatory-margin experiment family: commitments deliberately offset from regulation so the clean evidence region is conduct beyond requirement

T1.name: Discriminating core
T1.goal: Determine whether the commitment machinery is more than plumbing. If E5+E8+E17 fail here, the architecture measures the scheduler — learned with 7 services, not 27.

T1_5.name: Breach
T1_5.goal: Cheap addition: CBOR is a record; detection folds into CMR+BAM already present. Turns execution-against-commitment into evidence.
artifacts: Commitment Breach/Override Record (CBOR, 10.2) emitted by CMR+BAM

T2.name: Endogenous depth
T2.goal: Split appraisal from adoption and make adoption policy a first-class, gradeable, amendable object.

T3.name: Self-governance
T3.goal: Occupant-proposed future restriction with envelope safety. Re-enables the shared envelope engine, now justified by two consumers (SCR + APR amendments).

T4.name: Longitudinal & succession
T4.goal: Same-end-through-revision and accountable inheritance; the inseparability instrument.

T5.name: Adversarial blinding
T5.goal: Promote the air-gap to a governed quarantine and add sealing once blinding-compromise is a measured, not anticipated, problem.
